compiled_state.title: Add a workflow-config flag that creates PRs instead of merging to main
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body: Closing as already implemented. The requested feature — a workflow-config flag that creates PRs instead of merging directly to main — ships today as the consolidated knob dso.workflow=ci-pr (ci-pr = GitHub CI + PR-based merge; supersedes the deprecated merge.strategy=pr). Evidence: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md describes merge.strategy=pr / dso.workflow=ci-pr as 'creates a GitHub PR and waits for CI before merging'; consumed by merge-to-main.sh and hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh. This is a 0-child placeholder epic (never decomposed, no Closure Checks section), so completion-verifier has no manifest to validate; closing via force-close with codebase evidence instead.
